def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    ones=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    sixes=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==6]
    # Join any diagonally aligned pair of 1 markers.
    for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1)==abs(c2-c1) and r2!=r1:
                dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1
                dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
                for k in range(1,abs(r2-r1)):
                    out[r1+dr*k][c1+dc*k]=1

    for r0,c0 in sixes:
        r,c=r0,c0
        while r>=0 and c>=0:
            out[r][c]=6; r-=1; c-=1
        r,c=r0+1,c0+1
        while r<h and c<w:
            out[r][c]=6; r+=1; c+=1
    return out

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]

    if len(ones)>=2:

        dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1; dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
        n=min(abs(r2-r1),abs(c2-c1))
        for k in range(1,n):
            r,c=r1+dr*k,c1+dc*k
            if grid[r][c]!=6: out[r][c]=1

            r-=1;c-=1
        r,c=r0+1,c0+1
        while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
            if out[r][c] not in (1,): out[r][c]=6
            r+=1;c+=1
    return out
